name: id
business_description: Unique row identifier for this grant-wise bill.

name: created_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was created.

name: created_by
business_description: User who created the record.

name: modified_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

name: modified_by
business_description: User who last modified the record.

name: status
business_description: Lifecycle status of the bill.

name: action_status
business_description: Action status of the bill generation workflow.

name: beneficiary_id
business_description: Identifier of the beneficiary the bill is raised for.

name: district_id
business_description: Identifier of the district the bill belongs to.

name: farmer_id
business_description: Identifier of the farmer the bill is raised for.

name: farmer_name
business_description: Full name of the farmer the bill is raised for.

name: father_name
business_description: Father's name of the farmer.

name: funding_pattern_id
business_description: Funding pattern applied to the grant.

name: record_id
business_description: Identifier of the record this bill belongs to.

name: record_type
business_description: Type of record this bill belongs to.

name: record_type_id
business_description: Numeric code for the type of record.

name: beneficiary_category_id
business_description: Beneficiary category of the person the bill is raised for.

name: departmental_scheme_id
business_description: Identifier of the departmental scheme the grant belongs to.

name: grant_id
business_description: Identifier of the grant the bill is raised against.

name: email_id
business_description: Email address of the beneficiary or vendor.

name: mobile_no
business_description: Mobile number of the beneficiary or vendor.

name: registration_no
business_description: Registration number of the beneficiary or vendor.

name: vendor_address
business_description: Address of the vendor the bill is raised to.

name: vendor_name
business_description: Name of the vendor the bill is raised to.

name: vendor_registration_id
business_description: Registration reference of the vendor.

name: dbt_date
business_description: Date on which the direct benefit transfer was made.

name: dbt_no
business_description: Direct benefit transfer transaction number.

name: loan_bank_name

name: loan_branch_name

name: loan_ifsc

name: loan_account_no

name: iswithloan

name: office_type_id
business_description: Type of office the bill was generated for.

name: unit_id
business_description: Identifier of the unit or centre the bill belongs to.

name: role_id

name: financial_year_id
